AppUpToDate: EasyTier MyGo is up to date.
AppUpdateCheckFailed: Could not check for updates. Check the connection and try again.
AppUpdateInstallFailed: The update could not be installed. The current version keeps running.
AppUpdateUnavailable: This copy cannot update itself: it is updated by its package manager, or it is a development build.
SettingsCheckAppUpdatesHint: Reads the latest release from GitHub. Updates are signed, and installed only when you choose.
BannerHelperMissing: The privileged helper is not installed. Choose a run mode in Settings.
BannerHelperOutdated: The privileged helper is older than this app. Updating it needs administrator approval once.
BannerHelperStopped: The privileged helper is installed but not running. Starting it needs administrator approval.
BannerStale: No updates for a few seconds; the values below may be out of date.
ChartHint: Point at the chart to read a moment.
CoreUpdateAvailable: EasyTier {tag} is available. Download it in Settings → EasyTier core.
CreateBody: Enter the details your network's other members use, or import an EasyTier TOML file.
CreateMissing: Enter a name and a network name.
DeleteConfirmBody: The network is disconnected and its configuration deleted. This cannot be undone.
DetailAwaitingAddress: Waiting for a virtual IP address from the network.
DetailCollector: The connection status cannot be read right now. The network itself may still work.
DetailFailed: The network stopped working on this device. It is being restarted.
DetailNoPeers: Connected, but no other node is online yet.
DetailRecoveryExhausted: Automatic restarts stopped after repeated failures.
EditAdvancedHint: Routing preferences, protocols and the virtual device.
EditConflict: This configuration changed since you opened it. Close the editor and open it again.
EditFormUnavailable: This configuration has parts the form cannot show; edit it as TOML.
EditTomlHint: Comments and options the form does not show are kept as written.
EmptyBody: Create a network or import an EasyTier configuration to get started.
ErrorNeedsHelper: This network creates a virtual network device, which needs the privileged helper. Choose Follow GUI or Background service in Settings, or turn on “No virtual device”.
ErrorNoPkexec: pkexec is not available, so administrator approval cannot be requested.
EventConfigRollback: New configuration failed; returned to the previous one
FieldDHCP: Get a virtual IP address automatically
FieldExitNodesHint: Virtual IPs of nodes that route your internet traffic, one per line.
FieldInstanceIDHint: How EasyTier tells this device apart. A new one is filled in when it is empty.
FieldListenersHint: Where other nodes can reach this device, one per line. Leave empty to only connect out.
FieldNoTunHint: Works without privileges. Other nodes can reach this device, but this device cannot open connections to them.
FieldPeersHint: Addresses of nodes to connect to, one per line, such as a public server.
FieldProxiesHint: Local networks other nodes can reach through this device, one per line.
FieldSecretHint: Everyone in the network uses the same name and secret.
FlagDisableP2PHint: Never connect directly to other nodes.
FlagEncryptionHint: Encrypt traffic between nodes (all nodes must agree).
FlagExitNodeHint: Let other nodes route internet traffic through this device.
FlagIPv6Hint: Use IPv6 to reach other nodes.
FlagKCPHint: Carry TCP over KCP for lossy links.
FlagLatencyFirstHint: Choose routes by latency instead of hop count.
FlagLazyP2PHint: Open direct connections only when traffic needs them.
FlagMagicDNSHint: Resolve node names in the network.
FlagMultiThreadHint: Use several CPU threads for traffic.
FlagP2POnlyHint: Never relay traffic through other nodes.
FlagPrivateHint: Do not relay traffic of other networks.
HeaderPendingChanges: Saved changes are not applied yet.
ModeBackgroundBody: Networks run from startup, even when this window is closed or nobody is logged in.
ModeFollowBody: Networks run while EasyTier MyGo is open (including in the tray) and stop when you quit.
ModeFollowNeed: Administrator approval once; never again on start.
ModeUserBody: Networks without a virtual device run while the app is open. Nothing is installed.
NetworkNoneSelected: Choose a network on the left.
NotifyFailed: The network has a problem and is being restarted.
NotifyStillRunningBody: EasyTier MyGo keeps running in the tray. Quit it from the tray menu.
SettingsAdvancedHint: The diagnostics file holds versions, states and recent activity; never configurations or secrets.
SettingsCheckUpdates: Check for new EasyTier releases daily
SettingsCheckUpdatesHint: Only reads the release list from GitHub; nothing is downloaded automatically.
SettingsHideDock: Hide the Dock icon when the window is closed
SettingsCoresHint: Choose the EasyTier version your networks run on. Untested versions may not work with this app.
SettingsLaunchAtLoginHint: Starts EasyTier MyGo when you log in, so Follow GUI networks connect.
SettingsRunModeHint: Creating a virtual network device needs administrator rights. They are asked for once, when the helper is installed.
SettingsStartHidden: Start in the tray when opened at login
StoppedBackgroundNote: Background service is on: connected networks keep running when this window is closed.
StoppedBody: Disconnected. Connect to join the network.
ToastApplied: Applied. The network restarted with the new configuration.
ToastCoreSwitched: Core switched. Running networks restarted on it.
ToastNotConnected: Not connected to the background service.
TrayConnected: {count, plural, one {# network connected} other {# networks connected}}
WelcomeBody: Choose how your networks run. You can change this later in Settings.
WelcomeLater: Tip: start with No privileges if your networks do not need a virtual device.
NoDataBody: Traffic, nodes and activity show again as soon as the background service answers. Until then nothing here would be up to date.
SummaryUnavailable: This configuration has parts the summary cannot show. See Edit configuration.
SummaryPeersAbout: Where this device meets the other nodes.
SummaryAddressAbout: This device's address in the network.
SummaryDeviceOn: This device can open connections to other nodes.
SummaryListenersAbout: Other nodes can connect to this device here.
PeersHint: Right-click a node to copy its address
EditSecretAbout: Anyone who has it can join. Keep it private.
EditHostnameAbout: How other nodes see this device.
EditDHCPAbout: The network picks a free address for this device.
EditIPv4About: Used while the address is not assigned automatically.
EditDeviceAbout: Needed to open connections to other nodes. Off works without privileges.
EditDeleteAbout: Removes the network and its configuration from this device.
CreatePeerAbout: Where the nodes meet. Add more later in Edit configuration.
SettingsLanguageAbout: Follows the system unless you choose one.
SettingsThemeAbout: The sidebar's button switches it too.
SettingsStartHiddenAbout: Only the tray icon shows; the window opens from it.
SettingsCloseAbout: What closing the window does. Networks then run as the run mode says.
NotifyConnectionsAbout: A notification when a network connects, runs into a problem or recovers.
SettingsGeneralAbout: How EasyTier MyGo looks, starts and tells you about changes.
RunModeSwitchNote: Switching moves your networks along and reconnects the ones that were connected.
HelperNotInstalledAbout: It is installed when you switch to Follow GUI or Background service.
HelperAbout: Runs the networks for Follow GUI and Background service, and updates itself with the app.
CoreUpdateFound: EasyTier {tag} is available. It is downloaded only when you choose to.
CoresUnchecked: Check for releases to see what is available.
SettingsAboutAbout: This app's version and updates, and what to send when something goes wrong.
AboutDesign: Colors, node rows and the timeline follow EasyTier-iOS, whose artwork the icon uses.
AppUpdateInstallingAbout: In No privileges mode the networks pause until the new version starts.
AppUpdateAvailableAbout: Signed, and installed only when you choose. The app restarts.
DiagLogsAbout: This app's and its background service's logs.
